title: Authority Ledger Long-Form Editorial Sprite
created_for: Should You Read AI-Generated Code? — Long-Form Final
narrative_job: Make system of record concrete for one bounded beat.
selection_rationale: The system-of-record definition has protected negative space and benefits from one recognizable object. Portraits and the read-versus-verify still are scene media, not semantic sprites; this ledger is the film's only semantic accent.

generation.prompt: One mature clothbound ledger representing a system of record, shown closed in a slight three-quarter view, with visible layered paper edges, a narrow binding band, and one small plain seal clasp; refined indigo editorial illustration; no text, logo, watermark, extra object, shadow, glow, border, hand, person, or scenery; generated on a removable flat chroma-key background.

postprocess.method: Previously approved chroma-key alpha extraction, followed by a non-destructive transparent crop for long-form on-screen scale.

usage.motion: semantic-settle: 12-frame entrance with a 10-pixel upward settle; 11-frame exit; no rotation, bounce, loop, or reuse
usage.semantic_status: Illustrative visual mnemonic, not evidence or a depiction of a real system

asset_library.reason: Designed for this film's exact palette, metaphor, timing, and negative space.
